test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS 2022 - General Knowledge (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which among the following songs was composed by famous Indian musician Rahul Dev Burman?

options.text: Kisi Ki Muskurahaton Pe Ho Nisar

solution:
The correct answer is __**Yeh Dosti Hum Nahi Todenge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rahul Dev Burman was popularly known as Pancham Da.
 
• Rahul Dev Burman was an Indian music director. From the 1960s to the 1990s, Burman composed musical scores for 331 films.
 
• Rahul Dev Burman did major work with his wife, Asha Bhosle, and Kishore Kumar and scored many of the songs that made these singers famous.
 
• He also worked extensively and scored approximately 331 songs including some of the most memorable numbers in his career for Lata Mangeshkar.
 
• Nicknamed Pancham, he was the only son of the composer Sachin Dev Burman.
 
• Rahul Dev Burman laid the foundation for numerous Hindi film music directors to pave the path for the future of music in Hindi language cinema.
 
• On the anniversary of his 77th birthday on 27 June 2016, Google had a Doodle of R.D Burman on its Indian Home Page.
